understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to register WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved through the grid using directional movement or clicks at valid grid coordinates. Walls and obstacles blocked movement, and pieces could not pass through blocked spaces; clicking a selectable piece switched or targeted it, while clicking an accessible location moved the selected piece there. Movement had to be planned within the finite step limit, and merely alternating pieces without leaving them on all goals did not complete the level.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to register WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved through the grid using directional movement or clicks at valid grid coordinates. Walls and obstacles blocked movement, and pieces could not pass through blocked spaces; clicking a selectable piece switched or targeted it, while clicking an accessible location moved the selected piece there. Movement had to be planned within the finite step limit, and merely alternating pieces without leaving them on all goals did not complete the level.
